checked_routes.result: The current canonical review of this official catalog records multiple separately listed Fate titles. It establishes broad franchise context but cannot assign one HOME to every member of this 68-tag multi-work campaign.

The existing official-profile review matches five exact Fate/stay night identities to individual profiles and keeps the title-specific findings bounded to those members. The remaining campaign spans additional Fate works and is not covered by those five profiles.

The current official FGO Servant history lists entries such as Beni-enma and Jinako, but FGO appearances alone do not establish the original HOME for every returning character in this mixed Fate campaign. Exact other-work profiles are still required.

notes: The current official evidence covers only bounded title-specific subsets of this broad 68-member campaign. Existing Issue #180 decisions also keep exact Fate/stay night roots separate from the umbrella Fate root. Record partial progress only; make no campaign-wide HOME assignment and do not use later appearances as origin authority.
